title: Bihar Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
organization: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Bihar
vacancyDetails: Construction worker registration, welfare schemes and assistance services in Bihar.
qualification: Eligible registered construction workers under Bihar BOCW rules.
selectionProcess: Worker registration -> Document verification -> Welfare benefit processing
documentsRequired: Identity, residence, worker details, bank and employment documents.
howToApply: Open the Bihar BOCW portal, register as a worker and apply for the relevant welfare scheme.
shortDescription: Bihar construction worker registration and welfare scheme portal.
content:
The Bihar BOCW Welfare Board supports registration and welfare benefits for eligible building and construction workers.

Check the current scheme, registration validity, documents and application status through the official portal.
